gen-comfortaa-gf-stick: Neon-tube curves, loose and bouncy, with a ring-shaped c. Comfortaa carries that glow up top, while Stick's tubelike, constant-weight sans-serif lines keep the reading smooth and open as the text runs on.
gen-comfortaa-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antique: Springy, friendly geometry with a ring for a c. Comfortaa stretches its spacing like a coil, and Zen Kaku Gothic Antique, a sans-serif, settles into smooth, unobstructed bends beneath it.
gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-taviraj: Blunt, tubing-thick letters with a bookish partner. Aaargh does best at bold statements cut from one gauge of tubing; Taviraj does best at restrained stem-to-stroke difference and open curve endings.
gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-uchen: Round bowls, firm walls, zero fuss up top. Aaargh keeps its walls uniform all the way round, and Uchen brings an understated stroke contrast beneath, so the page gets muscle and manners together.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-cutive: Modern, geometric, and happily spaced out. Arkhip does best at flat, single-thickness display strokes, while Cutive does best at refined, widely tracked running text with a generous c.
